description: Codex: Orks (11e) HULKING BRUTES (Bully Boyz, 1 CP; +1 CP upgrade: every ranged attack, not only S > T) through the real enemy_targets_unit_shooting fold-in of the defender's reactive StratagemDialog. Fixture ork11e_orks_reactive: P1 Custodes ACTIVE, P2 Orks. Setup-only privileges: P2's detachment is flipped to Bully Boyz and its stratagems reloaded; the Nobz (engaged with Custodian Guard B in the fixture, so not a legal target) are moved 4" clear and the engagement flags recomputed. The Custodes player selects Custodian Guard C by clicking its token and declares its guardian spears at the Nobz (phase actions the shooting panel sends). The Ork player's dialog shows HULKING BRUTES with an enabled base button and an enabled '+1 CP: all ranged attacks' upgrade button; a real click on the upgrade spends 2 CP and marks the Nobz. No other reactive offer remains for the Nobz, so the dialog does not re-open (the re-open path is covered by ork11e_grot_shields) and the attack resumes; the Custodian Guard Sentinel Storm prompt that follows is declined. The Custodes resolve with the dock's Fast Roll / Complete Shooting buttons and the wound roll against the Nobz carries the -1 to wound.

steps.comment: setup privilege: the Nobz step 4" clear of Custodian Guard B so they are a legal target
the panel auto-highlights a shooter on phase entry; picking another unit first makes the Custodian Guard C token click a real selection
LIVE-2: the dialog sizes its card list to the content one layout pass after it opens
LIVE-2 / WH-8 / WS-9: every Use / option button is inside the visible part of the card list without scrolling, and the whole dialog is on screen
LIVE-10: the card's '+1CP Or:' upgrade is its own spelled-out line
steps.script:
var t = tree.root.get_node("StratagemDialog/Content/StratScroll/StratList/Card_faction_ork_bully_boyz_hulking_brutes/Effect").text
return t.contains("\n\nUpgrade (+1 CP) — instead: Ranged attacks") and not t.contains("CP Or:")

steps.comment: LIVE-10: the plain use and the upgrade both name their cost; the upgrade names its unit
equals: Upgrade on Nobz (2 CP): -1 to wound vs ALL ranged attacks

steps.comment: LIVE-9: the defender's reactive (enemy_targets_unit_shooting) dialog has the same Examine Board toggle as window mode
scroll the card's button row into view for the screenshot

steps.script: ScenarioRunner.event_log_count_containing("Used HULKING BRUTES (2 CP) on Nobz — -1 to wound vs ALL ranged attacks")
steps.comment: LIVE-10: the game log names the option that was bought
no other reactive offer remains for the Nobz, so the dialog does not re-open and the attack resumes

steps.script:

return d == null or not d.visible
